context_for_next_testing_agent: Unified AI Engine (Kairos AI Engine) fully implemented and tested. Combines Business, Coding, and Testing capabilities into single agent. Modes: auto (full pipeline), ba (business analysis), dev (coding), qa (testing). Chat endpoint calls Claude via Emergent LLM Key and returns tool_calls_executed, files_modified, questions, tool_results. Sessions persist in agent_sessions collection.

ai_engine_page.details: Page loads at /ai-agents with unified 'Kairos AI Engine' branding, mode selector, sessions sidebar, chat interface

session_management.details: GET /api/agents/sessions lists sessions, POST creates session with auto/ba/dev/qa modes, GET /{id} returns session, DELETE removes session

mode_selector.details: Dropdown shows Auto/Business/Coding/Testing modes with descriptions and color coding

chat_endpoint.details: POST /api/agents/chat returns response with tool_calls_executed, files_modified, questions, tool_results fields

testing_queries.details: POST /api/agents/testing/query supports: full_health_check, tb_balance, collection_stats, entity_validation, project_health

coding_file_apis.details: GET /api/agents/coding/files lists files, POST /api/agents/coding/read-file returns content. Correctly blocks .env and unauthorized directories

file_explorer_modal.details: Backend/Frontend buttons open file explorer modal showing project files with sizes

tests_dropdown.details: Quick Tests button shows dropdown with Health Check, Trial Balance, Collection Stats, Entity Validation, Project Health options

starter_prompts.details: 5 starter prompts clickable and populate input field

sidebar_label.details: Sidebar shows 'AI ENGINE' section (not 'AI Agent Hub')

tool_results_display.details: Tool execution results shown with expandable cards showing tool name, args, and result JSON

sessions_api.POST /api/agents/sessions: 200 - Creates session with id, agent_type (auto/ba/dev/qa), title, messages, timestamps
sessions_api.GET /api/agents/sessions/{id}: 200 - Returns session details, 404 if not found

testing_queries_api.POST /api/agents/testing/query: 200 - Supports: full_health_check, tb_balance, collection_stats, entity_validation, project_health

coding_files_api.POST /api/agents/coding/read-file: 200 - Returns file content, blocks .env files and unauthorized paths

chat_api.POST /api/agents/chat: 200 - Returns {response, agent_type, session_id, timestamp, tool_calls_executed, files_modified, questions, tool_results}
